entities.name: Otte Wallish
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Otte Wallish was a Czech–Jewish artist and émigré to Mandatory Palestine who established himself as a graphic designer and contributed to the symbolic self-representation of the newly founded State of Israel as a Jewish state.
